tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rten bskyed kyi yi ge ma rig mun sel ces bya ba bzhugs// na mo gu ru kirti ma ti buddha dhwa dza ye/ dus gsum rgyal ba rgyal sras rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /kun gyi spro dang bsdu ba'i byed po gang / /yab gcig he ru ka dpal rdo rje 'chang / /dus gsum sgrib med gzigs der snying nas 'dud/ /ces mchod par brjod nas/ 'dir rab tu gnas pa'i rten bskyed kyi cho ga ma rig mun sel bri bar bya'o/ /de la rten rnams a mṛ tas bsangs/ shū n+ya tas rten rnams mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bla ma yi dam/ sangs rgyas byang sems/ chos skyong nor lha'i sku thams cad padma nyi ma bdud bzhi brtsegs pa'i gdan gyi steng du/ oṃḥ.āḥhūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i rdo rje 'chang kyai rdo rje sku mdog dkar po zhal brgyad phyag 'dir ni bsdus pa'i dbang du byas pa ste/ rgyas par na thub dbang / rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje sems dpa' rnams dang / gzhan yang sangs rgyas byang sems yi dam zhi khro'i tshogs dang / sa skya pa'i chos skyong khyad par can rnams sogs ngo shes shing de dang de'i bskyed chog ngag 'don thub pa rnams la so so'i mngon rtogs bzhin bskyed nas zhal bsgyur yang mi dgos par gsungs shing / 'dir skabs kyi lha thams cad kyi cho ga gsum bskyed dam/ yang na sa bon gang yin las nges par bskyed dgos shing / skad cig gis bskyed pa 'dir mi rung bar rab gnas kyi bshad pa thams cad du gsungs la/ yang rab gnas dngos grub 'byung ba las/ de bzhin du gtso bo gang yin pa de gong bzhin rgyas par bskyed/ ces pa'i tshig la 'khrul nas grub thob brgyad cu dang / gnas brtan bcu drug sogs kyang bris 'bur gyi gtso bo la yod na rang rang gi mngon rtogs bzhin bskyed nas zhal bsgyur mi dgos par sems pa ni rab gnas kyi cho ga dang /

bshad pa thams cad dang 'gal ba yin te/ de'i tshul rnams rje btsun gong ma'i yig cha rnams la zhib 'jug byas pas go ba yin no/ /bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dkar po/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dmar/ steng zhal dud kha/ zhal lhag ma gnyis gnag pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ phyag bcu drug gi g.yas brgyad na rdo rje dang / g.yon brgyad des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lngas dbu brgyan cing / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas gnyis brkyangs pa'i brla la/ g.yon gnyis bskums pa'i sor mo rnams gtad pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ sgeg pa dpa' ba sogs/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje bdag med ma sku mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du gyur/ dkyil 'khor rnams pam̐ las padma/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje ra nyi shu pa/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / lte ba mthing nag la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ 'khor yug rdo rje'i ra ba dang / drwa ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/ phyi rol thams cad ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis mdzes pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyi rol tu dur khrod brgyad dang bcas pa dang / srung 'khor dur khrod med pa rnams 'od zer phreng ba sogs dkyil 'khor so so'i mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du so so'i lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i gdan gyi steng du gtso 'khor thams cad oṃ āḥhūm̐ las rdo rje oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa lha grangs dang mnyam pa yongs su gyur pa las/

bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' kyai rdo rje sku mdog dkar po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas brgyad rdo rje/ g.yon brgyad des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dkar mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i sku can du gyur/ chos pu sti dang gzungs dang yig 'bru rnams rma byas btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri padma nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du dzriṃ las padma dzriṃ gis mtshan pa las 'od dpag med kyai rdo rje sku mdog dmar po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas brgyad na padma/ g.yon brgyad na des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum gos dkar mo dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du gyur/ thugs mchod rten gyi rigs rnams padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la bhrūm̐ las 'khor lo bhrūm̐ gyis mtshan pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyai rdo rje sku mdog dkar po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas brgyad na 'khor lo dang / g.yon brgyad na des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du gyur/ de 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i chos sku'i mchod rten tshad dang mtshan nyid rgyan la sogs pa yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa'i bum pa'i nang du padma dang nyi ma'i gdan lnga'i dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ bhrūm̐ las 'khor lo bhrūm̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyai rdo rje sogs dang / shar du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las mi bskyod pa kyai rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas brgyad rdo rje/ g.yon brgyad des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum mā ma ki sngon mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/

lho aṃ las rin po che am̐ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rin chen 'byung ldan kyai rdo rje sku mdog ser po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas brgyad rin po che/ g.yon brgyad des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rin chen sgrol ma ser mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ nub tu dzriṃ las padma dzriṃ gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ 'od dpag med kyai rdo rje sku mdog dmar po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas brgyad padma/ g.yon brgyad des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum gos dkar mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ byang du kham̐ las ral gri kham̐ gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ don yod grub pa kyai rdo rje sku mdog ljang khu zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas brgyad ral gri/ g.yon brgyad des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang khu gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ rigs lnga thams cad kyang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i sku can du gyur/ ༈ /gur zhal sogs thun mong ma yin pa'i chos skyong gi sku rnams hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las mi bskyod pa kyai rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas brgyad rdo rje/ g.yon brgyad des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum mā ma ki sngon mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du gyur/ ༈ /gtsug lag khang 'di nyid padma dang nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du bhrūm̐ las 'khor lo bhrūm̐ gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rnam par snang mdzad kyai rdo rje sku mdog dkar po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas brgyad na 'khor lo dang / g.yon brgyad des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du gyur/

de zhu ba las byung ba'i gtsug lag khang tshad dang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa'i nang du padma dang nyi ma'i gdan lnga'i dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bhrūm̐ las 'khor lo bhrūm̐ gyis mtshan pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyai rdo rje sogs dang / shar du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las mi bskyod pa kyai rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa sogs/ mchod rten gyi skabs sgra ji bzhin la cung zad mi 'dra ba ni rigs lnga thams cad kyang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i sku can du gyur pa'i byang shar du gur gyi mgon po lha brgyad/ zhing skyong gdong bzhi pa sogs chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs rnams dang / shar lhor rnam thos sras dzambha la nor rgyun ma dmar po skor gsum dbyug gu ma mched gsum sogs nor lha'i tshogs rnams gsal bar bzhugs gtsug lag khang la gzhan bskyed chog mchod rten bzhin las/ lhag par chos skyong dang nor lha 'di bzhin bskyed dgos par/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i dngos slob chos rje shes rab rgya mtsho bas mdzad pa'i rab gnas kyi phyag len dang / bshad pa'i zin bris mthong ba rnam grol ces bya bar gsungs shing de dang mthun pa yang rje rdo rje 'chang gi rab gnas don gsal la bshad pa rgyas pa gnang skabs/ sdom brtson dpal gyi ye shes kyis zin bris su mdzad pa'i rab gnas kyi rnam bshad mig thur gsal byed sgron me zhes bya ba las kyang 'byung bas 'di la dgos ched khyad par can yod par rtogs pas ma chad pa gal che'o/ /pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba dang bcas par gyur/ lha de thams cad kyi dpral bar zla ba'i steng du oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par padma'i steng du āḥdamar po/ thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po sogs gzhung bzhin bya'o/ /zhal bsgyur gyi skabs su/

bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs chos skyong nor lha sogs/ rdo rje 'chang rdo rje sems dpa' kyai rdo rje bskyed pa rnams 'od du zhu/ bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs chos skyong nor lha la sogs pa so so'i sku'i rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin du gyur/ gur zhal sogs mi bskyod pa kyai rdo rjer bskyed pa rnams 'od du zhu/ chos srung de dang de'i sku'i rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin du gyur/ chos pu sti sogs yig 'bru'i tshogs 'od dpag med kyai rdo rjer bskyed pa rnams 'od du zhu/ lung rtogs kyi bdag nyid chos dkon mchog dbyangs gsal gyi yi ge a l̥ ka li rnams glegs bam sogs kyi gzugs ji lta ba bzhin du gyur/ ces brjod/ gzhan zhal bsgyur mi dgos pa rnams la gang yang brjod mi dgos pa lags/ 'di dag gi mtha' dpyod rgyas par ni rab gnas don gsal gyi dgongs don rnams zhib tu bshad pa'i legs bshad rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa kho bos byas pa'i rab gnas kyi rnam bshad rin po che'i gter mdzod ces bya ba/ rab gnas kyi phyogs la mkhas par 'dod na med thabs med pa'i yig cha zhig yod pas der blta bar bya'o/ /skabs 'dir 'phros don cung zad cig brjod na/ 'gran zla dang bral ba'i skyes chen sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i rab gnas dngos grub 'byung ba las/ rab gnas kyi cho ga la rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gsungs pa'i/ dang po rgyas pa la nub gsum la dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i lugs dang / dkyil 'khor dang ma 'brel ba nub gnyis ma'i lugs dang gnyis su gsungs pa'i/ phyi ma nub gnyis ma'i lugs kyi cho ga'i rnam gzhag rnams gsungs pa'i rjes su/ ding sang nub gnyis ma'i phyag len 'di cung mi dar ba 'dug pas ma go ba'i gtam ma smra shig don gsal la zhib tu gzigs na bkra shis pa'i yan lag tu 'gyur zhing / phyag len bde bas thams cad dgyes pa'i rgyur 'gyur ro/

/rab gnas nub gnyis ma 'di nub gsum ma'i cho ga dang bsres nas gsungs shing / gong ma'i gsung rab rdo rje'i tshig yin pas/ rang gi dad pa dang bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis go ba ma gtogs kun gyis go bar ma nges so/ /zhes gsungs pa la chos rje ngor pa dkon mchog dpal ldan gyis/ zur za ba'i tshul gyis kho rang gis mdzad pa'i kyai rdor rnam bshad du/ mchod pa dang gtor ma bya bar sgrub thabs mtsho skyes las gsungs/ rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras dang / de'i brgyud pa 'dzin pa rnams maṇḍal mchod chog rgyas pa mdzad pa la maṇḍal bsgrub mchod ces kyang bya/ thun mtshams kyi bya ba zhes kyang bya/ mchod gtor gyi rnal 'byor zhes kyang bya/ phyi rol tshogs bsog gi rnal 'byor zhes kyang bya'o/ /che btsun kha cig cho ga 'di la brten pa'i rten la rab gnas rgyas 'bring gnyis byed pa'i phyag len dang / grub mtha' gsar pa 'dug na'ang / rje gong ma rnams mi mdzad cing ma gsungs pas rtog dpyod dang ldan pa rnams kyis zhib len mdzad 'tshal/ zhes bris par snang ngo / /de'i dogs pa sel bar byed pa la sngags 'chang bla ma'i dgongs pa 'di nyid la/ gnod byed tshad ldan med par bstan pa dang / sgrub byed rnam dag yod par bstan pa gnyis las/ dang po la/ tshad ldan lung gi gnod byed med pa dang / yang dag rig pas gnod byed med pa'o/ /gnyis pa sgrub byed rnam dag yod par bstan pa la lugs 'di rtsod med phyag len gzhan las bshad tshul bstan pa dang / de nyid dmigs bsal gyi rab gnas la sbyor mi rung ba tshad ldan lung rigs gang gis kyang bsgrub mi nus pa bstan pa dang / bka'i dgongs pa rang dbang du 'grel nus pa'i grub pa'i skyes bu la gang zag so skyer bzung ba dam pa'i spyod tshul ma yin par bstan pa dang / sa skya pa'i man ngag zab dgu snyan rgyud du bzhugs pa gzhan thams cad la yang som nyi za bar khas len dgos par bstan pa sogs cung zad spro bar 'dod kyang /

'dir yi ges 'jigs nas ma bris la/ rgyas par logs su 'chad par spro zhing / sngags 'chang bla ma sprul pa'i sku de nyid kyi rjes 'jug rnam dpyod dang ldan pa gzhan dag gis kyang smra bar mi rigs so/ /hai/ de skad 'di ni dpyod ldan gzur gnas kyi/ /'gro kun dga' ba'i blo gros bzhin dwangs pa/ /skal bzang bsod nams can yid 'phrog pa des/ /legs bshad mig 'dzum sbrang rtsi spel phyir bkod/ /ces pa 'di yang sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis bris pa dge legs 'phel/ yang smras pa/ maṇḍal sgrub mchod dang 'brel ba'i nyin gnyis pa'i sta gon gyi skabs su mdun bskyed dang 'brel ba'i gtor bsngo byed dgos par 'dra ba zhig gong nyin gsum ma la kha 'phangs gnang ba las thon yod kyang / nyin gnyis ma'i rab gnas sta gon gyi skabs su mdun bskyed gang yang med pa nas/ de'i snga dro mdun bskyed dang 'brel ba'i gtor bsngo dgos rgyu min par snang zhing / de bzhin cho ga 'bring po'i skabs su yang de dang 'dra bas chog par sems la/ rab gnas dngos gzhi'i gsol gdab gang 'di ma'i skabs su/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di rab tu gnas par bgyi'o zhes pa yod kyang / rab gnas kyi bshad pa rnams su lo rgyus dang bcas te/ 'di rnams kyi'am/ yang na 'di dag gi rab tu gnas par bgyi'o zhes mang tshig brjod dgos par gsungs shing / sngags 'chang chen po'i phyag dpe dngos las kyang 'di'i skabs su bris bsub mdzad de/ 'di dag gi zhes bsgyur ba gnang 'dug pas/ rjes 'jug blo ldan rnams kyis dgongs 'tshal/ kalyā na wardhantu/ maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 a myes zhabs/ rten skyed kyi yi ge ma rig mun sel/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 5
